next.reason: 1985 VII.4.5.3 SR1: REWRITE 'Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not refer to the same storage area' (a compile-time refusal). 2023 has no such syntax rule: §2023:14.9.35.4 GR7 makes REWRITE ... FROM a MOVE to the record followed by REWRITE, and its NOTE 2 applies the overlapping-operand and MOVE rules 'to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area ... share any part of their storage areas'; §2023:14.9.35.4 GR10 contemplates identifier-1 being 'one or part of one of the record descriptions'. Under §2023:14.6.10 GR1 the result is undefined unless the items share a data description entry (§2023:14.6.10 GR2: as if no overlap). A source 1985 refuses is accepted; no exception condition replaces the refusal.
